definitions.explanation: Describes a material that is thicker than the standard version — typically used for fabrics, paper, cardboard, and ceramic dishware. Usually appears as {厚手|あつで}の + noun.

examples.japanese: {厚手|あつで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦セーター→セーター：01371_seetaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}た→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{厚手|あつで}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{丈夫|じょうぶ}→丈夫：01156_joubu⟧だ。
examples.english: This paper is thick and durable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{厚手|あつで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カーテン→カーテン：01342_kaaten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{替|か}える→替える：13399_kaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かく→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: In winter, switching to thick curtains makes the room warmer.

notes:
Compound of {厚|あつ} (thick) + {手|で} (here a suffix indicating quality/grade of material).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {厚手|あつで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧: thick fabric
- {厚手|あつで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧: thick paper / heavyweight paper
- {厚手|あつで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コート→コート：01358_kooto⟧: a heavy coat
- {厚手|あつで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{靴下|くつした}→靴下：00726_kutsushita⟧: thick socks
- {厚手|あつで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食器|しょっき}→食器：04204_shokki⟧: heavyweight dishes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {薄手|うすで}: thin; lightweight — the direct opposite
- ⟦{分厚|ぶあつ}い→分厚い：10502_buatsui⟧: thick (more general, can describe books, walls, etc.)
